intervention: pFBA restriction -- force off every gene-associated reaction carrying no flux in the parsimonious solution for that medium

scope_note_2026-08-12.status: STANDS AS MEASURED on the 4-media substrate; GENERALITY UNKNOWN
scope_note_2026-08-12.history: A same-day memo asserted this result was 'now suspect' because it shared the narrow 4-media substrate. That assertion is WITHDRAWN -- it was itself an unverified claim. The rate-matched null (0/200 draws reached the observed value) is internally valid on the substrate it was run on. What is unknown is whether the gain GENERALISES to a wider condition panel, which is untested.
scope_note_2026-08-12.named_weakness: The rate-matched null samples cells INDEPENDENTLY, while real gene patterns are correlated across conditions. A null preserving gene-level and condition-level margins would be a stronger test, and should be built before the claim is extended.
scope_note_2026-08-12.named_weakness_status: STILL OPEN: the rate-matched null samples cells independently while real gene patterns are correlated across conditions. Unaffected by the 2026-08-13 work.

caveats: pFBA restriction is a CRUDE proxy for regulation -- it forces off ~69% of gene-associated reactions. It is evidence about WHERE the deficit lives, not a deployable method.
The gain is RECALL, not precision: precision does not improve, and the threshold-free AUROC gets WORSE, so the continuous ranking degrades even as the binary calls improve.
Still only a handful of exact-set matches -- the switch is mostly still not reproduced.
pFBA picks ONE optimal-flux solution; alternate optima of equal cost would force off a different route and could change which genes look essential.

superseded_by.outcome: NUMBERS UNCHANGED AND CONFIRMED -- superseded by a better-grounded artifact, not retracted.
superseded_by.what_was_tested: Whether the lift was an artifact of NaN growth (= a non-optimal solve) being coded as ESSENTIAL. The restricted arm has 74 non-optimal cells of 268 (27.6%), so the concern was material.
superseded_by.result: REFUTED. Those solves are deterministic ATPM-maintenance infeasibility, i.e. genuine essentiality -- verified by re-solving the 39 equivalent cells on the carbon panel one at a time (39/39 infeasible; each the canonical catabolic gene for that source; 38/39 experimentally essential there). Abstaining them removes TRUE POSITIVES: TP collapses 56 -> 12.
superseded_by.note_on_the_precommitted_rule: A rule authored BEFORE the run said 'A <= abstained-null-max -> SOLVER_ARTIFACT'. It fired. Its PREMISE -- that abstaining on non-optimal solves is the conservative move -- was false, so a correctly-fired rule produced a false label. Pre-committing a rule does not pre-commit its premise.
